## <br>`r if (exists("TITLE", inherits = FALSE)) TITLE else "Newmark Displacements $D_n$"`

```{r}
IDn.target <- c("ensemble", "rigid", "flexible")
IDg.target <- IDg.gmdp
Da.target  <- Da.gmdp
p.target   <- c(0.05, 0.10, 0.16, "mean", 0.84, 0.90, 0.95)
if (!exists("CAP", inherits = FALSE)) CAP <- "Newmark sliding-block model. Residual displacements [cm] for geometry %s (scenario %d). Ensemble, rigid, and flexible quantiles are reported for target ground motion with 1/%.0f AEP [1/yr]."
TR.label <- prettyNum(TR.gmdp, big.mark = ",", scientific = FALSE)
```

```{r}
ID.target <- .resolveDerivedIDTarget(
  DnTable,
  "Newmark slide",
  suffix = ".max",
  target = .currentTarget("ID.target"),
  siteID = .currentTarget("siteID.target")
)
```
